'''Nesan 26 (November 21)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Nynaeve]], [[Elayne]] and [[Min]] capture the ''[[sul'dam]]'' [[Seta]]. They take her with them to the ''[[damane]]'' quarters.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Rand]], [[Mat]], [[Perrin]], [[Hurin]] and [[Ingtar]] enter [[Falme]]. Hurin leads them to [[Turak]]'s house. Rand glimpses Egwene. Battle with Turak and his men; Rand kills Turak. They escape with the [[Horn of Valere|Horn]] and the [[dagger]].
*{{ne|998}} - The girls rescue [[Egwene]]. Outside, they fight against [[Seanchan]] ''damane''.
*{{ne|998}} - Seanchan pursue Rand's party. Ingtar reveals he was a [[Darkfriend]], and sacrifices himself so the others can escape. They see Seanchan and [[Whitecloaks]] approaching from opposite directions. Mat sounds the Horn. The [[Heroes of the Horn]] appear, and Rand orders them to drive out the Seanchan. The Whitecloaks charge, and battle begins. Rand confronts [[Ba'alzamon]], who wounds him in the side but is apparently killed in turn.
*{{ne|998}} - [[Bayle Domon]] and [[Spray]] escape from Falme during the battle.
*{{ne|998}} - Min finds Rand in Falme. She is confronted by [[Lanfear]].
